data.text: You approach the outermost fence of the airport grounds, and find an enormous gremlin camp there. Cobbled-together cars idle as their drivers chat and guffaw with their lesser trolley-riding compatriots. There are so many gremlins that it would be very difficult to take them on yourself.
You should probably get some help. Maybe you can convince airport security to help, or maybe you can make friends with a gremlin elsewhere?
